<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Api;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\Url;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse;

class UrlController extends Controller
{
    public function index(): JsonResponse
    {
        return response()->json(Url::all());
    }

    public function store(Request $request): JsonResponse
    {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'column1' => 'required|string',
            'column2' => 'required|string',
            'column3' => 'required|integer',
        ]);
        $model = Url::create($validated);
        return response()->json($model, 201);
    }

    public function show(Url $url): JsonResponse
    {
        return response()->json($url);
    }

    public function update(Request $request, Url $url): JsonResponse
    {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'column1' => 'required|string',
            'column2' => 'required|string',
            'column3' => 'required|integer',
        ]);
        $url->update($validated);
        return response()->json($url);
    }

    public function destroy(Url $url): JsonResponse
    {
        $url->delete();
        return response()->json(null, 204);
    }
}
